output:
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id), 1)

Need LEFT JOIN so plans with no members show... division by zero yields NULL in SQLite, fine.

```sql
SELECT p.name,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id), 1) AS pct_members_with_trip
FROM plan p
LEFT JOIN member m ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN trip t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.name
```
